caption:
You can't stop chasing their approval. But what if you were already free from the very verdict you keep begging for? (Galatians 6:14 devotional)

You turn good things into your identity and then can't stop begging the world for its verdict. But at the cross Christ crucified that verdict's power over you — "crucified to the world" means its approval no longer rules you, and the good things you clung to aren't worthless, they're simply dethroned. Now you're finally free to love the very world you no longer need, boasting in nothing but the cross.
